references.text: The first census of the tribe of Issachar showed 54,400 men, which can be compared with the number 64,300 here, indicating an increase in the size of the tribe.
Mentions the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvva, Job and Shimron, who are the founders of the clans counted in this verse.
Describes the birth of Issachar as a son of Jacob and Leah, the patriarch of the clans counted here.
Provides a detailed genealogy of Issachar's descendants and their numbers, supplementing information about the clans of Issachar.
Describes the placement of the tribe of Issachar in the camp and its leader, Nethanel son of Zuar, with 54,400 men.
